description: Office of the Chief Secretary - Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Removal of the Chairman of the Embilipitiya Urban Council, Mr. W. B. G. L. Dharmakeerthi
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the dismissal of a local government official (Chairman of the Embilipitiya Urban Council) by the Provincial Governor following a disciplinary inquiry and tribunal process. It involves law enforcement and administrative action against a public official for alleged offenses under the Urban Council Ordinance, falling under judicial/law enforcement matters rather than central government personnel or structural changes.
